facts.claim: The survey of the Bodie town-site was scheduled to start on Monday, March 20, 1880 at 10 a.m.
facts.quote: Notice is herebv given that the survey of said town-site in the manner as provided for in Paragraph 15,961 of the Statutes and Codes of the State of California, will commence Monday the 20th day of March, 1880 at 10 o'clock A.M.
